events_retention_floor.name: events_retention_floor
events_retention_floor.using: delivered_at is not null and occurred_at < now() - interval '1 day'

users_email_whole.name: users_email_whole
users_email_whole.value: ("tula"."users"."email" IS NULL) = ("tula"."users"."email_normalized" IS NULL) AND ("tula"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "tula"."users"."email_verified_at" IS NULL)

webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.name: webhook_deliveries_retention_floor
webhook_deliveries_retention_floor.using: state <> 'pending' and created_at < now() - interval '7 days'
